owner_and_capability: Care Plan — careplan.Capability Commands and Queries for care offerings, offering change requests, companion edges and child documents, consumed without the dissolved modules/careplan/legacy root package (#3410)
atomic_cutover: The root package modules/careplan/legacy is deleted in one PR together with every import of it. The care-offering and offering-change repositories become the enrollment services' own translation onto careplan.Capability, with the queue's name search as a consumer-owned port bound to the People Directory by the services composition. The companion and child-document repositories become constructors next to the sibling Care Plan adapters in database/repositories. Four repositories.Factory fields are removed, so database/repositories no longer imports models/enrollment. The calendar day comes from compose.Today and the ambient transaction from compose.TenantAmbientDatabase. Every repository still delegates to the same careplan.Capability methods; no statement and no second provider is added.
tests: scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast: the full backend suite, including the companion, care-document, care-offering and offering-change behaviour tests, the parent-portal and request-queue route tests and the query-budget tests.
services/enrollment/care_offering_repository_test.go, the repository contract test moved together with its adapter.
modules/careplan/compose/ambient_database_test.go for the ambient transaction resolver, including the panic on a transaction it cannot join.
scripts/backend-architecture.sh check with the listed keys absent from legacy.jsonl.
